visual_enhancers.corners: rounded-3xl for cards, rounded-full for buttons and pills
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] for standard cards. shadow-[0_4px_0_rgb(234,226,216)] for 'game-like' clickable buttons (claymorphism).
visual_enhancers.borders: Use border-2 border-[#EAE2D8] on cards to give them a tangible, medkit feel.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat colors for clinical areas. Use very subtle noise/grain texture on the main background.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped, chunky, with a bottom 4px solid shadow to look like a game button. Active state translates down 4px and removes shadow.
components.cards: White background, large 24px border radius, 2px warm border, soft ambient shadow. Inner padding p-6 or p-8.
components.dialogue_bubble: Floating with a gentle up-down bounce animation. 'Listening...' indicator should have 3 dots pulsing sequentially.
components.action_dock: Sticky bottom dock, segmented controls like a game inventory. Uses pill-shaped tabs.
components.phase_stepper: Horizontal timeline with circular nodes. Completed nodes are Mint Green, current is Coral, future is greyed out.
components.odontogram: Interactive SVG with 32 teeth. Hover states highlight individual teeth. Click to select. Minimalist pastel coloring for teeth.

layouts.landing: Bento grid for case cards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6). Max width 5xl. Generous top/bottom padding.
layouts.simulation_room: Flex column desktop-first layout. Top: Vitals & Stepper. Middle: 60vh container with Isometric Scene (background image/color) + 3D patient avatar centered + Chat overlay floating left/right. Bottom: Action dock.
layouts.debrief: Split layout. Left: Score overview (large circular progress, grade). Right: Scrollable breakdown lists (asked vs missed, red flags).

motion.listening_pulse: animate-pulse on the mic icon or 3 dots.
motion.patient_avatar: Gentle float (translate-y-2 back and forth over 4 seconds) to simulate breathing.
motion.page_transition: Fade in and slight slide up for new screens.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on primary/secondary colors is pure white. Text on accent backgrounds should be dark brown/grey.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-case-btn', data-testid='push-to-talk-btn').
accessibility.bilingual: Provide a TR/EN toggle that updates all UI strings.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Setup Tailwind with the custom colors provided in 'colors'. Update index.css to map these hex codes to CSS variables. Add fonts Playful 'Nunito' and clean 'Figtree' to the project.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Build standard UI components: Game-style pill Button (with 4px bottom shadow), Rounded Card (24px radius, 2px border).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Implement the state management for Language (TR/EN), Case Selection, and Simulation Phases (Anamnez, Klinik Muayene, Testler, Tanı, Tedavi Planı).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Build Landing Page: Header with TR/EN toggle and Demo link. 4 Case cards displaying title, difficulty, chief complaint.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Build Briefing Modal/Screen: Details about the case, scoring dimensions, and 'Start' button.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Build Simulation Room: Use the isometric background image. Place the patient avatar in the center. Add the animated dialogue bubble. Build the Vitals/Phase Stepper at the top. Build the Chat transcript and Push-to-Talk input. Build the Action Dock with tabs for phases. Implement the SVG Odontogram for the 'Klinik Muayene' phase.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_7: Build Debrief Report: Score calculation display, grade, checklists, and examiner narrative. Add 'Copy Summary' functionality.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_8: Ensure footer disclaimer 'Eğitim amaçlıdır — klinik karar aracı değildir / For education only — not a clinical decision tool' is on every page.

universal_guidelines: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for elements with content under them.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Avoid generic centered layouts, use grid and flex to create structure.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
